attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Nursing (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops, conferences, lectures or in-service offerings that build nursing knowledge, judgment and skills (nursing, health sciences, management, ethics/law, teaching etc.); also authorship, presentations, QA/risk studies, research, or 2+ academic credits (1 credit = 15 contact hours)
rules.alternatives: Current national certification may be used to fulfill the CE requirement. Licensees may request inactive status instead of meeting CE.
rules.audit_note: Every 100th renewal application is selected for a CE audit at least 45 days before the renewal date; OPLC checks the licensee's CE Broker account. Licensees must keep accurate CE records.
rules.legal_basis: N.H. Admin. Rules Nur 401.01 and Nur 403; RSA 326-B:22
rules.notes: Biennial renewal due by midnight on the licensee's birthday in the renewal year. Nurses without an active license anywhere in the US for 5+ years must complete a re-entry program (e.g. 120-hour refresher). A Nur 400 rule revision was proposed in 2026.
rules.rule_quote: (a) Each applicant for licensure by endorsement, renewal or reinstatement for an RN or LPN license shall complete at least 30 contact hours of workshops, conferences, lectures or in-service educational offerings that are designed to enhance nursing knowledge, judgment, and skills.
